text:
maria: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — API ref for POST /v1/generate

maria: two quick problems I found while trying to sync SDK examples:
- temperature param documented as integer enum (0|1) — should be a float in [0.0,1.0]
- response schema in the reference omits the "warnings" array we ship from the runtime
I pushed a tiny failing example test to the PR so CI shows the mismatch.

sam: nice catch. can you paste the broken snippets here so i can update the SDK snippets too?

maria: sure — current doc shows this (wrong):
```yaml
parameters:
  temperature:
    type: integer
    enum: [0, 1]
```
should be:
```yaml
parameters:
  temperature:
    type: number
    format: float
    minimum: 0.0
    maximum: 1.0
    description: "Sampling temperature between 0.0 (deterministic) and 1.0 (stochastic)"
```

maria: and the response — docs only list id/choices/tokens. runtime currently adds warnings like this:
```json
{
  "id": "r-123",
  "choices": [{"text": "Hi"}],
  "tokens": 12,
  "warnings": ["truncated_prompt"]
}
```
This matters for teams that parse warnings for degraded-quality experiments.

raj: I can update the OpenAPI YAML in the repo to make temperature a number and add the warnings property (array of strings). Note: our generator turns OpenAPI number -> TS number fine.

emma: thanks — can you also add a short example in the API ref showing how to handle warnings in responses? i.e. a small snippet that checks warnings and logs them. Might help product teams migrating.

oliver: +1, also add a migration note under docs/migration/v1.0.md about the schema change (temperature type) so users know to review any strict-typed client code.

maria: done — pushed edits, added example snippet and migration note. Also fixed an internal link that CI flagged.

ci-bot: docs/lint found 1 broken internal link in files changed (docs/guides/usage.md#generate-params)

maria: fixed that link and force-pushed.

ci-bot: All checks passed ✅ (unit, lint, openapi-check)

sam: reviewed, small wording nits only. LGTM from eng side.

emma: reviewed doc examples, very clear. Approving now.

sam: merging PR into main.

maria: thanks team — i'll open a follow-up to propagate the warnings handling example into the JS/TS SDK README and add a note in the changelog.

emma: perfect, thanks :tada:
